LOCAL AUDIO LIBRARY — CC0 1.0

All WAV files in this directory are original procedural synthesis generated by
scripts/generate-audio.mjs for this project. They contain no sampled recordings
or third-party music. The generated audio is dedicated to the public domain
under CC0 1.0 and may be copied, modified, distributed, and reused without fee.

Runtime playback is entirely local. No generative service, paid API, streaming
site, analytics endpoint, or token-based system is used to create or play it.
